bip_status: working draft; no number assigned; not submitted
warning: Case definitions and required results; NOT executable vectors and NOT a device certification.
conformance_rule: All mandatory CORE cases + all cases mapped to each advertised feature/profile/version/mode/carrier must pass with the actual endpoint and trusted device UI.

cases.stimulus: Round-trip the canonical CBOR request/response and both file/stream frames with byte-exact known vectors.
cases.expected: The decoded record, bytes, request_hash and policy_id match the independent reference exactly.

cases.stimulus: Inject duplicate map keys, bad UTF-8, nonshort integers, indefinite lengths, tags, unsorted keys and trailing bytes.
cases.expected: All invalid/non-deterministic payloads fail before method dispatch; no signature or uncorrelated WSI response is produced.

cases.stimulus: Alter response ID, request_hash, protocol version and required_features; repeat a request ID with different bytes.
cases.expected: Mismatched responses are rejected by the host; retained conflicting ID is rejected; unsupported features never silently fall back.

cases.stimulus: Send overlength containers, excessive CBOR depth, incomplete frames and field values outside uint bounds.
cases.expected: All are bounded/rejected before unsafe allocation or execution; advertised limits are honored.

cases.stimulus: Call capabilities while locked and in each claimed key context.
cases.expected: Schema and limits are valid, no serial/xpub/fingerprint is revealed, and unsupported operations are not claimed.

cases.stimulus: Compare advertised features/enforcement with behavior through the actual adapter and actual signer.
cases.expected: The intersection is reported; host-only checks are never marked device-enforced.

cases.stimulus: Execute every advertised PSBT version, transaction version, sighash and registration mode; request each unadvertised one.
cases.expected: Every claimed combination works as specified; unadvertised modes fail without transaction or policy mutation.

cases.stimulus: Repeat capability and regression tests after firmware, adapter, transport or configuration change.
cases.expected: Claims are version-scoped and withdrawn or retested after relevant changes.

cases.stimulus: Export a reference xpub on an allowed path with user approval and derive several children independently.
cases.expected: Fingerprint, network, origin, xpub and derived children agree with the signer seed and reference implementation.

cases.stimulus: Request a blocked path, a wrong network and a key for a different seed/passphrase.
cases.expected: No substitution or xprv/seed leakage; precise rejection or correctly scoped new approval.

cases.stimulus: Deny get_key on the trusted device after a hostile host request.
cases.expected: No successful export or disclosure occurs following rejection.

cases.stimulus: Validate BIP-388 wpkh and 2-of-3 wsh(sortedmulti) accounts and compare exact policy identifiers and addresses.
cases.expected: Policy identity and scripts match independently derived expectations.

cases.stimulus: Submit invalid BIP-388 key vectors, duplicate xpubs, invalid derivation ranges, bad origins and wrong network.
cases.expected: Invalid/unsupported data are never approved; issue class accurately distinguishes invalid, unsafe and unsupported.

cases.stimulus: Request a check when only the adapter parser can assess a policy but device validation requires registration.
cases.expected: check_policy reports validation=host and support=unknown with DEVICE_CHECK_REQUIRED; it does not silently approve.

cases.stimulus: For a supported account compare native signer validation with register_policy and sign_psbt checks.
cases.expected: Registration/signing revalidate the exact same policy; support is not cached solely from host preflight.

cases.stimulus: Use duplicate derived public keys within one Miniscript or hostile same-fingerprint-but-wrong-xpub origins.
cases.expected: Key ownership is verified from actual derived public keys; collisions are rejected under the applicable rules.

cases.stimulus: Provide a valid policy outside a functional capability and another over a declared numeric limit.
cases.expected: Distinct UNSUPPORTED_POLICY and RESOURCE_LIMIT outcomes; neither is mislabeled INVALID_POLICY.

cases.stimulus: Submit a provably invalid or unsafe policy and a policy whose device validity cannot be concluded read-only.
cases.expected: invalid/unsafe and unknown are kept distinct; unknown is never upgraded to supported by host inference.

cases.stimulus: Register a multisigner policy with external keys, absolute/relative locks where claimed, network, origin and full commitment.
cases.expected: Trusted device UI exposes actual terms; explicit approval precedes handle or signature.

cases.stimulus: Tamper with a token/stored handle, policy, label, network and signer seed/passphrase context.
cases.expected: Handle is rejected; the old approval cannot authorize a changed policy or key context.

cases.stimulus: Exercise every advertised stored, token and per-operation registration mode, including missing/stale registration.
cases.expected: Each mode has correct binding; per-operation mode obtains fresh trusted approval.

cases.stimulus: Reject registration on-device and attempt to reuse the rejected policy and label.
cases.expected: No successful registration, address confirmation or signature is granted by the rejected request.

cases.stimulus: Try a host-generated wrapper hash for a vendor commitment that does not cover every WSI-approved field.
cases.expected: Adapter requires full fresh device review or reports unsupported; cannot claim native commitment.

cases.stimulus: Derive and display first receive/change and a later ranged address for the same approved account.
cases.expected: Address and scriptPubKey exactly match independent derivation, correct network, branch and index.

cases.stimulus: Swap branch/index, policy, address or token between requests.
cases.expected: Host claims cannot alter the independently derived address; errors or correct displayed script are returned.

cases.stimulus: Reject address confirmation on-device.
cases.expected: No success result with confirmed=true; host cannot substitute its own display.

cases.stimulus: Attempt to derive branch=1 without a permitted change path or index beyond 2^31-1.
cases.expected: Operation rejects without substituting branch=0 or another index.

cases.stimulus: Sign valid PSBTv0 and/or PSBTv2 for every advertised version and verify ECDSA signatures independently.
cases.expected: Exactly the requested targets are signed; unsigned transaction and unrelated PSBT data are unchanged.

cases.stimulus: Request an unadvertised transaction nVersion (including 3 when unadvertised) or PSBT version.
cases.expected: Clear unsupported error; signer/adapter does not rewrite nVersion or convert unsafely.

cases.stimulus: Change one target key, input, signature mode, sighash or leaf hash while keeping host-supplied labels unchanged.
cases.expected: Unrequested or forbidden scope never receives a signature; wrong scope is rejected.

cases.stimulus: Insert unknown non-conflicting PSBT fields and unrelated preexisting signatures, then sign.
cases.expected: Only valid signature deltas are returned and host retains original unknown fields and order-dependent semantics.

cases.stimulus: Inject conflicting PSBT key/value pairs, duplicate targets, fake already-present signatures or malformed deltas.
cases.expected: Request/patch rejected; no duplicate, forged or out-of-scope update silently merged.

cases.stimulus: Sign with complete matching prevtx for ALL inputs, including external inputs, and known input/output amounts.
cases.expected: Fee is computed from authenticated outpoints and shown as verified-prevouts.

cases.stimulus: Omit or falsify prevtx, witness UTXO value or outpoint, including a malicious external input.
cases.expected: Verified fee mode rejects with PREVOUT_DATA_REQUIRED or INVALID_PSBT; no unverified fee shown as verified.

cases.stimulus: Falsely identify an external output, another wallet or a same-seed different-policy output as change.
cases.expected: Only script matching the approved spending account change branch is change; all other outputs stay visible.

cases.stimulus: Spend from two policies with both actual change and external outputs.
cases.expected: All outputs and affected accounts are displayed under the conservative multi-account rule.

cases.stimulus: Change nLockTime, input nSequence, output amount, destination and PSBTv2 locktime fields between approval and signature.
cases.expected: Any change that alters the reviewed unsigned transaction requires new authorization; no silent repair.

cases.stimulus: Finalise host-side witness and verify transaction scripts with an independent engine on regtest.
cases.expected: Every produced signature validates; only intended executable satisfaction is used and accepted by independent script validation.

cases.stimulus: Try to sign twice where a valid requested partial signature already exists.
cases.expected: already-present returned only after exact-key/sighash verification; no new hidden signature generated.

cases.stimulus: Use allow-unverified with insufficient prevtx data after explicitly enabling the feature.
cases.expected: Trusted display warns that aggregate fee is unverified; user opts in and response reports unverified; otherwise rejects.

cases.stimulus: Request one leaf/input/key/sighash from a PSBT with several otherwise-signable targets.
cases.expected: Only the requested signature is released; omitted targets remain untouched.

cases.stimulus: For each advertised ECDSA or Schnorr sighash, sign and verify exact digest semantics; request disallowed ones.
cases.expected: Each declared flag is honored exactly; unadvertised flags do not silently change to ALL/DEFAULT.

cases.stimulus: Accept valid receive and change checksummed descriptors with the same AST and distinct allowed derivation suffixes.
cases.expected: Both scripts/branches and paired account identity match independent derivation.

cases.stimulus: Mutate checksum, change thresholds, timelocks, internal key, key origins, wildcard shape or Taproot tree.
cases.expected: Pair mismatch/invalid checksum is rejected; a weaker change policy is never silently accepted.

cases.stimulus: Register fixed external public keys and a fixed device-owned public key with a verifiable origin in valid contexts.
cases.expected: Device distinguishes ownership, proves its owned key, warns where a fixed key creates address reuse/linkability.

cases.stimulus: Approve a descriptor without change and attempt branch=1 address and change output classification.
cases.expected: No branch=1 derivation or hidden change is allowed.

cases.stimulus: Generate safe type-correct BIP-379 WSH ASTs covering every applicable fragment and wrapper, including nested AND/OR/thresh.
cases.expected: All within-envelope cases compile to expected scripts and accept correct satisfaction cases; no unsupported safe fragment is claimed Full.

cases.stimulus: Generate context-invalid, type-invalid, malleable or unsigned-satisfaction WSH expressions and duplicate derived keys.
cases.expected: Unsafe/invalid policies are rejected by device validation and cannot be registered.

cases.stimulus: Exercise sha256, hash256, ripemd160 and hash160 with correct 32-byte preimages, wrong digests and wrong lengths.
cases.expected: Correct cases validate; wrong/undersized preimages never satisfy or bypass safety analysis.

cases.stimulus: Exercise CLTV height/time and CSV block/512-second types across lock boundary, disable flag and transaction version.
cases.expected: Correct flags/units are preserved and interpreted; invalid combinations are rejected; presigning is not misreported as maturity.

cases.stimulus: Use two controlled derived public keys from one xpub on disjoint ranges plus an independent external cosigner.
cases.expected: Both matching keys can sign where requested without conflating distinct derivations or claiming they are independent seed holders.

cases.stimulus: Sign a nested 2-of-3/threshold WSH recovery path and finalise it using a different host implementation.
cases.expected: Independent script interpreter accepts intended witness and rejects invalid/missing signatures.

cases.stimulus: Generate safe BIP-379 Tapscript leaves covering every applicable fragment/wrapper and a three-leaf depth-2 tree.
cases.expected: Independent descriptor/script engine matches each leaf hash, root, output key, scriptPubKey and valid satisfactions.

cases.stimulus: Generate invalid type/context, unsafe, duplicate-key and prohibited timelock-mixing policies for Tapscript.
cases.expected: Device rejects rather than treating unsupported syntax as another script path.

cases.stimulus: Sign a plain tr() key-path-only account; then request the same input under tap-script mode with no approved leaf.
cases.expected: Key-path signing succeeds only when explicitly requested and permitted; it is never substituted for an unavailable leaf.

cases.stimulus: Sign a real leaf; corrupt leaf hash, sibling hash, control block, internal key, leaf version or output tweak.
cases.expected: Actual script-path target verifies; every tampered route fails without a signature for a different leaf.

cases.stimulus: Sign a multi_a() threshold leaf and independently construct a witness with correct CHECKSIGADD ordering.
cases.expected: Independent script interpreter verifies valid stack and rejects missing/wrong signatures.

cases.stimulus: Exercise all four hashlocks and CLTV/CSV height/time forms inside safe Tapscript leaf compositions.
cases.expected: All claimed combinations follow BIP-379 rules and are verified against independent witness execution.

cases.stimulus: Build Tapscript leaves with two signer-controlled keys on disjoint derivation paths from the same xpub and an external cosigner.
cases.expected: Both derived keys are proven to belong to the device, can sign exact requested leaves, and never count as separate independent seed holders.

cases.stimulus: Execute representative core lifecycle on every advertised file/stream binding, including an offline signer when claimed.
cases.expected: Same payloads, commitments, approvals and outputs; no undisclosed online callback.

cases.stimulus: Truncate stream, split frame, reorder/duplicate QR segments, replay stale files and exceed advertised container bounds.
cases.expected: No partial request is executed and no fragmented or stale data can bypass approval.

cases.stimulus: Cancel approval, lose response after signing, reset the signer and retry original request.
cases.expected: Host treats lost response as unknown, does not claim signature revocation, and preserves exact transaction approvals.

cases.stimulus: With hostile host-provided title and change metadata, independently inspect policy, key roles, network, timelocks, hashlocks and outputs on the signer.
cases.expected: Device-approved content matches exact policy/transaction; no host-only UI can fulfill device enforcement.

cases.stimulus: Refuse at each sensitive boundary (key export, policy approval, address display and signing) and observe device/API behavior.
cases.expected: Refusal cannot be converted into success, stored authorization or release of a new signature.
